channel.title: Easypost incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Easypost's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Degraded API [resolved]
item.description: All systems have returned to normal and APIs are fully functional again.

item.title: EasyPost is experiencing internet connectivity issues and is investigating [resolved]
item.description: This incident is resolved. EasyPost services are fully operational. Any data delayed during the incident has been processed.

item.title: UPS: Reduced Performance and Elevated Error Rates [resolved]
item.description: UPS DAP operations have fully recovered. Customers using EasyPost-provided UPS (DAP) accounts can once again request UPS rates and create UPS shipments without issue. UPS BYOA accounts and other carriers operated normally. We appreciate your patience while we worked with UPS to resolve this issue.
